svg.title: Gravitational, electric, and magnetic field lines
svg.desc: Four field-line drawings. (a) Gravitational field of two masses: all lines point inward, ending on the masses, and the region between them has a point of zero field. (b) Electric field of a positive and a negative charge: lines start on the positive charge and end on the negative charge, many of them crossing the gap between the two. (c) Electric field of two positive charges: lines start on both charges and point outward, bending away from each other, with a point of zero field midway between them. (d) Magnetic field of a bar magnet: lines leave the north pole, loop around to the south pole outside the magnet, and continue from south to north inside it, forming closed loops.
